reason: The iron-bearing fraction must be separated from the screened regolith first, but the board does not identify a separator.
expectation: The inspection should reveal what can help separate or process the feedstock.

effect: Screened regolith has no available partner yet, so a separation tool or preparation must come first.
reaction: I am curious what the available workshop parts can make.
reason: Steel may be useful for making a separator, but its available partners are not yet clear.
expectation: The inspection should identify a compatible first construction.

alternatives.reason: The retort might reveal what preparation it needs.

effect: The steel and power cable made a separator electromagnet, providing the missing tool for the iron-bearing fraction.
reaction: The switchable magnet makes the separation method clear.
reason: The electromagnet should separate the magnetic fraction from the screened regolith.
expectation: The magnet will collect the iron-bearing grains for the retort.

effect: The magnet produced iron-rich concentrate suitable for processing in the retort.
reaction: The distinction between magnetic separation and identifying minerals by color is useful.
reason: The concentrate is the prepared feedstock for the materials retort.
expectation: The concentrate will be loaded into or processed by the retort.

effect: The concentrate cannot be used yet, so the retort likely needs preparation first.
reaction: The failed attempt makes the required setup less clear.
reason: Inspecting the retort should reveal how to prepare it for the concentrate.
expectation: The retort will show its available setup partner or automatically combine if there is only one.

effect: The retort is now connected to hydrogen and solar heat, ready for the concentrate.
reaction: The missing preparation now makes sense.
reason: The prepared concentrate belongs in the hydrogen-fed retort.
expectation: The retort will process the concentrate using heat and hydrogen to produce iron.

effect: Hydrogen reduction produced porous iron sponge, which needs further processing at the press.
reaction: The explanation makes hydrogen's role in removing oxygen clear.
reason: The result says the iron sponge is carried to the press, so pressing is the next step toward usable iron.
expectation: The press will compact the weak iron sponge into a more usable form.

effect: The heated press consolidated the sponge into a dense iron billet; the next goal is to make a process frame.
reaction: The distinction between consolidating the iron and shaping parts is useful.
reason: The process frame likely needs the consolidated iron and the prepared fuel-fab footing.
expectation: The iron will be shaped and installed as a frame at the fuel-fab site.

effect: The press shaped the billet into iron bars and brackets, so the frame can now be assembled from those parts.
reaction: The automatic press operation clarified the missing shaping step.
reason: The bars and brackets are suitable non-pressure supports for a frame at the prepared fuel-fab site.
expectation: The supports will be assembled into a process frame on the footing.

effect: The bars and brackets became a process frame on the footing, completing the chapter's goals.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the local iron become a support for the planned gas installation.

mostWorthwhile.text: Reducing the concentrate and consolidating the sponge made the progression from mineral to usable metal understandable, including hydrogen's role and the need for a controlled heated press.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the concentrate directly with the unprepared retort was unproductive; the missing hydrogen connection was not clear until the retort was inspected.

surprise.text: Inspecting steel automatically made a switchable electromagnet; the explanation showed how the collected grains could be released.

arbitrary.text: The billet needed a separate shaping operation before it could become a frame. That requirement was not obvious from the goal, although the press result explained it.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see the gas installation and return plan develop, especially after this chapter connected local materials processing to the mission.
